desc: Ideation: identify black set as a downset / Ferrers shape with monotone row and column cutoffs.
Confirm criterion: feasible iff no white cell (wx,wy) is dominated by a black cell (bx,by) with wx ≤ bx and wy ≤ by (closure(B) ∩ W = ∅).
Implement O(M log M): sort blacks by x, suffix-max of y, binary-search per white point to test domination.
Validate against Sample 1-4 and an exhaustive brute-force staircase check on small N, including equality/tie edge cases.
Finalize Python stdin/stdout program (Yes/No), O(M log M) time, O(M) memory.
